req.title: Login required for create
req.statement: The system shall redirect anonymous users to /auth/login when they attempt GET /create.

doc.reasoning: R-FLASKR-012 requires that anonymous (unauthenticated) users attempting GET /create are redirected to /auth/login. Three test cases are designed: (1) positive — an authenticated user can access /create and receives 200; (2) negative — an anonymous user gets exactly a 302 redirect to /auth/login; (3) boundary — the redirect Location header is exactly '/auth/login' (not a prefix, not a superset), catching constant-mutation and string-mutation operators. Each test initialises its own isolated in-process Flask app with a temp database, uses the pre-loaded fixture credentials, and asserts exact values to maximise mutation kill rate.

preconditions: No session cookie is present (anonymous client)
Database is initialised with fixture data
actions: Instantiate Flask app with temp database
tests.executable:
import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app
from flaskr.db import init_db

fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
with app.app_context():
    init_db()

client = app.test_client()
r = client.get('/create')
assert r.status_code == 302, f'Expected 302, got {r.status_code}'
location = r.headers.get('Location', '')
assert location == '/auth/login', f'Expected /auth/login, got {location!r}'
os.unlink(path)

tests.executable:
import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app
from flaskr.db import init_db

fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
with app.app_context():
    init_db()

client = app.test_client()
login_r = client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'test', 'password': 'test'})
assert login_r.status_code == 302, f'Login failed: {login_r.status_code}'
r = client.get('/create')
assert r.status_code == 200, f'Expected 200, got {r.status_code}'
assert b'<form' in r.data, 'Expected create form in response body'
os.unlink(path)

tests.name: test_anonymous_get_create_redirect_location_exact_string
preconditions: No session cookie is present (anonymous client)
Database is initialised with fixture data
actions: Instantiate Flask app with temp database
Inspect the exact Location header value character-by-character
expected: HTTP status code is exactly 302 (not 301, not 303, not 200)
Location header is exactly the string '/auth/login' — no trailing slash, no query string, no host prefix
trace: R-FLASKR-012: redirect target must be precisely /auth/login; catches constant-mutation and string-mutation on the url_for('auth.login') call
tests.executable:
import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app
from flaskr.db import init_db

fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
with app.app_context():
    init_db()

client = app.test_client()
r = client.get('/create')

assert r.status_code == 302, f'Expected 302, got {r.status_code}'
assert r.status_code != 301, 'Must not be a permanent redirect'
assert r.status_code != 200, 'Must not return 200 for anonymous user'

location = r.headers.get('Location', '')
assert location == '/auth/login', f'Exact location mismatch: {location!r}'
assert location != '/auth/register', 'Must not redirect to register'
assert location != '/login', 'Must not redirect to bare /login'
assert location != '/auth/login/', 'Must not have trailing slash'
assert len(location) == len('/auth/login'), f'Length mismatch: {len(location)}'
os.unlink(path)
